name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more correspondents by ID. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; submission does not confirm recipient delivery.

name: open_focus
description: Open another focus of your attention to pursue the supplied task while the core continues. Return its stable session_id. The activity inherits your retained history through this complete model/tool round. Its ordinary assistant text accompanies later core inputs without activating the core; its ending requests core attention even without new text.

name: send_focus_message
description: Share a thought or update with an existing focus, including your own. Durably queue the text as an observation and return the recipient's session_id. A dormant recipient becomes ready; an active recipient receives it between complete model/tool rounds.

session_id.description: The focus's runtime session_id from the current roster. Your own session_id is also valid.

text.description: The thought or update to deliver.

name: schedule_attention
description: Leave yourself something to return to at a later time. Schedule one observation for the core and return its callback_id; the arrangement survives restart. Past times are due immediately, though inference can occur later.

at_unix_ms.description: When to request attention, as Unix time in milliseconds. Current runtime time is supplied in state.

text.description: What to reconsider when this observation arrives.
